necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Given a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring via CPT 93271 is indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to these symptoms. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of the service despite the payer's denial based on Reason Code CO-97.
